description:
Goal
Replace the compiler2 semantic/artifact root-pass path with a product-keyed pull path. The new path starts from the front-door demand for BackendProgram(root), pulls only the products named by local dependencies, and packages the final backend program after the demanded symbolic products exist.

Signal
For fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz, --log-telemetry shows fewer jobs than the current branch, zero SealSemanticClosure jobs on the new product path, zero production root_executable_frontier/root scan calls, zero follow_up producer pokes in the new path, and the same external result: main/0[] => {int, int}; both reducer operator refs resolve to direct Kernel.+/2 callable transport with no first-class boundary.

Strategy
Execute the detailed plan in ../pull-based.html as one commit-sized ticket per DAG step. Build the product driver and request-local PullSession first, then add semantic/runtime-demand products, transport products, materialized/effects products, ABI/backend products, final packaging, telemetry proof, legacy deletion, and docs closeout.

Guardrails
No walkers. No passes. No self-scheduling. No whole-root fact scans. No root frontier under a new name. New product producers must return product waits, not follow_up jobs. Sorting is allowed only for local deterministic output or final dense packaging, never for semantic discovery or demand inclusion.

Reference
Plan artifact: ../pull-based.html.
title: Compiler2 pull-based artifact path: replace semantic/root passes with product-keyed demand
